mapper.sql: select tag_id, name, slug, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from cms_tag
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0' and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and slug = #{slug}
order by tag_id desc

select t.tag_id, t.name, t.slug, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from cms_tag t inner join cms_article_tag at on t.tag_id = at.tag_id where at.article_id = #{articleId} and t.del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from cms_article_tag at inner join cms_article a on a.article_id = at.article_id where at.tag_id = #{tagId} and a.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into cms_tag (name, slug, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{name}, #{slug}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update cms_tag set del_flag = '2' where tag_id in #{id}
